items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'WILLIANS' only as a header/metadata tag. The interviewee (Mary Lou Williams) does not mention anyone named Williams in the spoken text, nor does she describe a personal relationship with a person named Williams.

ctx.x: No. The strangest thing happened after the musicians found out that I was playing with them. They used to come by the house, when I was between the ages of 8 and 10 or 12, when I was in grade school, and take me out. and pick me up mother, a I had a family that didn't mind. In the beginning they had an older member to go with me and after a while some
musician would get her confid_ence, gain her confidence and then she'd allow me to go with them.
